# Reference photos

Photos of my own clothes, shoes and bags, taken by me (Aaron Campbell), for checking that the renderer's 3D view
looks like the real item. They're part of this repository under its licence (see `LICENSE`).

Each file is saved without its camera metadata (no location, device or date).
